  Scenario: System Availability
    Given the system is running
    When the system is under high load
    Then the system availability should be at least 99.999%

  Scenario: System Availability with Outage Window
    Given the system is running
    When the current time is 10 minutes before the next Sunday
    Then the system should be down for maintenance

  Scenario: System Availability Boundary Test
    Given the system is running
    When the system is under 99.998% load
    Then the system availability should be at least 99.998%

  Scenario Outline: Backup Every Night
    Given the system is running
    When the current time is 00:00:00
    Then a full backup should be created
    Examples:
      | day_of_week | hour | minute |
      | Sunday      | 23   | 59     |
      | Monday      | 0    | 0      |
      | Tuesday     | 0    | 0      |
      | Wednesday   | 0    | 0      |
      | Thursday    | 0    | 0      |
      | Friday      | 0    | 0      |
      | Saturday    | 0    | 0      |

  Scenario Outline: Backup Failure
    Given the system is running
    When a backup fails
    Then an alert should be sent to the support team
    Examples:
      | failure_type |
      | disk_full    |
      | network_issue|
      | software_error|

  Scenario Outline: Rollback by a Month
    Given the system is running
    When a rollback is requested
    Then the system should be rolled back by a month
    Examples:
      | rollback_type |
      | full_rollback |
      | incremental_rollback|

  Scenario Outline: Backup Restoration on Dummy Production System
    Given a backup is created
    When the backup is restored on a dummy production system
    Then the backup should be restored successfully
    Examples:
      | backup_type |
      | full_backup |
      | incremental_backup|

  Scenario Outline: Purge Dummy Production Database
    Given a backup is restored on a dummy production system
    When the dummy production database is purged
    Then the dummy production database should be empty
    Examples:
      | purge_type |
      | full_purge |
      | incremental_purge|

  Scenario: Data Storage Compliance
    Given the system is running
    When the data is stored in Mangalore HQ
    Then the data should be stored in a fireproof cabinet 25 KM away from the Hospital
    And the system should comply with health care regulations as defined by Government of India

  Scenario: Compliance with Specific Regulations
    Given the system is running
    When the system is designed
    Then the system should comply with specific regulations (e.g., HIPAA equivalent)

    When the current day is a 2nd Sunday

    When a rollback request is made for the last month
    Then the system should be rolled back to the state of the backup from the last month
    And the rollback should be completed within 2 hours

  Scenario: Post back-up everyday the back-up shall be restored on a dummy production system to ensure completeness and correctness of back-up
    Given the system is operational
    When a backup is completed
    Then the backup should be restored on a dummy production system
    And the restoration should be completed within 1 hour
    And the dummy production database should be purged

    Given the system is operational
    When the data is stored
    Then the data should be stored in a fire proof cabinet in Mangalore HQ
    And the distance between the hospital and the fire proof cabinet should be 25 KM

  Scenario: The system shall be designed to comply with health care regulations as defined by Government of India
    Given the system is operational
    When the system is used
    Then the system should comply with all health care regulations as defined by Government of India
